preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of kinds of pairs of brackets k must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= abs(s_i) <= k for s_i in s)
preconditions.description: Each bracket in the string s must be an integer with absolute value between 1 and k.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all((query[0] == 1 and 1 <= query[1] <= n and 1 <= abs(query[2]) <= k) or (query[0] == 2 and 1 <= query[1] <= query[2] <= n) for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must be valid, with type 1 queries having valid indices and bracket types, and type 2 queries having valid substring ranges.

postconditions.description: For each type 2 query, output 'Yes' if the substring is a correct bracket sequence, otherwise output 'No'.
